That, as 17 we spoke earlier, can have manifestation in 18 the resting electrocardiogram as a 19 prolonged QT interval in the absence of any 20 medications. 21 There's a variant on that theme called the 22 "Brugada syndrome" that also has to do with 23 abnormal passage of electrolytes across the 24 cell membrane. For better or worse, that 25 leaves no footprints behind on the autopsy. Geralyn C. Barker, CCR, RMR 985-626-5195
